sampling: Five fresh processes per layout through 100k keys; three per layout at one million keys
load_order: Layouts alternate each round; the one-million tree sample 1 runs first as a bounded-memory check
cache_state: All files were generated before load; no cache flush; not device-cold
load_timer: File open, metadata, buffer allocation, sequential read, and structure construction; stops before retained structure destruction
peak_memory: Maximum resident set size in bytes; whole process, no baseline subtraction
inputs_and_binary_cleanup: Completed with lastdb-dev reclaim --home OWNED_SCRATCH --exact-home; exit 0; released exact synthetic seed
